# Sql.Databases

```m
Sql.Databases(server as text, optional options as nullable record) as table
```

Returns a table of databases on a SQL Server.

*Description: Microsoft, MIT ([THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../../../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)).*

Reference: [Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powerquery-m/sql-databases)

|---|---|---|
